item.title: Bennett boys advance to 3A Region Semis over Northern
item.description: SALISBURY, Md. – James M. Bennett boy’s basketball beat Northern 66-56 in Salisbury Friday night to advance to the 3A East II Region Semifinal. The Clippers were led offensively by Khiyen Tilghman (21 points), Kyler Dickerson (14 points), and Josiah Wigfall (13 points). Bennett will go on the road to play Old Mill on Monday, March 2.
